title: Free Spins Offers: The Conditions Worth Reading First
summary: Learn which expiration, wagering, cashout, game and eligibility conditions to inspect before interpreting an online casino free-spins promotion.
body:
## Free does not necessarily mean unrestricted

A free-spins banner may describe how a promotional benefit is received, not the full conditions that control its use. Even when an offer says no deposit is required, it may still have eligibility rules, deadlines, game restrictions or conditions attached to winnings.

## Confirm how the promotion is awarded

Check whether the spins require a new account, a verified identity, a deposit, a promo code, a specific game or another action. Look for a published start and end date. Avoid treating an old social post as evidence of a currently active offer.

## Check which games count

A promotion may limit eligible titles, stake values or availability. An eligible game list is more useful than a generic claim of access to thousands of slots. If an operator's written rules are hard to find, do not assume that any slot will qualify.

## Understand wagering and cashout limitations

The promotional terms may specify requirements before bonus-associated funds can be withdrawn, or may limit the amount that can be redeemed. Pay attention to whether playthrough is applied to the bonus, winnings, deposit plus bonus, or another stated basis. Use hypothetical calculators to understand the arithmetic, not to predict outcomes.

## Read the deadline and forfeiture provisions

The spins themselves may expire, or related promotional balances may have a separate deadline. Find out how the rules treat unused spins, canceled bonuses, interrupted sessions and changes to account eligibility.

## Keep a dated reference

Save the full current terms before opting into an offer. The headline, date, participating game, and conditions should all be considered together. If important information is missing, ask support in writing. Do not assume that screenshots of a promotional card contain the complete agreement.

## The practical conclusion

A large free-spins number is not a reliable measure of value. RawEdge focuses on explaining the conditions that shape an offer, without claiming an unverified promotion is available or that spins can guarantee a win. For adults only where legal; play responsibly.
